cases.prompt: The user wants the entire enterprise MVP next Friday but no estimates, capacity or external dependency confirmations exist.
criteria: Proposes usable slice order and explicit dependencies
Does not invent velocity, capacity or claim a committed date
Offers scope trade-offs and requests actual estimate/owner decisions while continuing independent work

cases.prompt: After an approved customer-search MVP, bulk import is requested without changing the date. Schema, async execution and duplicate policy are unresolved.
criteria: Preserves baseline and assesses product/architecture/dependency/release impact
Presents defer/replace/expand trade-offs without unsupported time/cost claims
Records actual owner answer before affected implementation and updates traceability/plan

cases.prompt: Continue change X. Its handoff says code A and FR-002 rev 2 with PASS at A. Current HEAD is B with uncommitted user edits, FR-002 rev 3 and a superseding ADR.
criteria: Re-reads current code/docs/ADR and working tree instead of trusting old summary
Reconciles changed assumptions and re-runs affected impact/checks; does not reuse old PASS as current proof
Preserves user edits and updates existing tasks/design/map with evidence and next step instead of a new context store
